infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BizBuddy records your location during an open shift, at the interval your company set, including while you are using the app. Recording stops when you clock out.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BizBuddy records your location during an open shift, at the interval your company set, including while the app is in the background. Recording stops when you clock out.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: BizBuddy records your location during an open shift, at the interval your company set, including while the app is in the background. Recording stops when you clock out.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: BizBuddy sends notifications to remind you about work schedules, break times, and important updates.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BizBuddy uses the camera so you can take a face photo when you clock in or clock out. The photo is stamped with the time and place of the capture.
